# MotoLog

> MotoLog is a mobile app that helps motorcycle riders keep track of due services, log mileage and record trips, so nothing gets missed and the service history stays in one place.

## Pages

- [Home](https://www.moto-log.app/): what MotoLog does and how to get the app
- [Features](https://www.moto-log.app/features): service reminders, mileage logging and trip tracking
- [How it works](https://www.moto-log.app/how-it-works): from adding a bike to staying on top of maintenance
- [FAQ](https://www.moto-log.app/faq): common questions about the app
- [Blog](https://www.moto-log.app/blog): guides for riders on maintenance, mileage and trips

## Blog articles

- [Motorcycle fluids explained: what each one does and when to check it](https://www.moto-log.app/blog/motorcycle-fluids-explained): Oil, coolant, brake fluid, clutch fluid and fork oil all keep your motorcycle running safely. Here is what each fluid does, how to check it and roughly how often it needs changing.
- [What to do if your motorcycle breaks down on a trip](https://www.moto-log.app/blog/what-to-do-if-your-motorcycle-breaks-down-on-a-trip): A breakdown far from home is stressful, but a calm plan makes it much easier to handle. Here is what to do if your motorcycle stops on a trip, from getting safe to simple roadside checks and calling for help.
- [How to read a motorcycle tyre sidewall](https://www.moto-log.app/blog/how-to-read-a-motorcycle-tyre-sidewall): The numbers and letters on your motorcycle tyre tell you its size, speed rating, load rating and age. Here is how to decode them so you buy the right replacement and spot tyres that are past their best.
- [How to choose a motorcycle jacket](https://www.moto-log.app/blog/how-to-choose-a-motorcycle-jacket): A good motorcycle jacket protects you in a fall and keeps you comfortable in all weathers. Here is what to look for in materials, armour, fit and ventilation before you buy.
- [How to ride in a group on a motorcycle trip](https://www.moto-log.app/blog/how-to-ride-in-a-group-on-a-motorcycle-trip): Riding with friends is one of the best parts of motorcycling, but a group needs a little organisation to stay safe and together. Here is how to plan and ride a group trip that everyone enjoys.
- [How to sell your motorcycle: prepare it, price it and close the deal](https://www.moto-log.app/blog/how-to-sell-your-motorcycle): A little preparation can add real money to your sale price and make the whole process faster. Here is how to get your motorcycle ready to sell, set a fair price and hand it over safely.
- [How to choose motorcycle boots](https://www.moto-log.app/blog/how-to-choose-motorcycle-boots): Your feet and ankles take a beating in even a minor fall. Here is what to look for in motorcycle boots, from protection and fit to waterproofing, so you buy a pair you will actually wear.
- [How to work out your motorcycle's fuel consumption](https://www.moto-log.app/blog/how-to-work-out-motorcycle-fuel-consumption): Knowing how far your bike goes on a tank helps you plan rides and spot problems early. Here is a simple way to measure your motorcycle's real fuel consumption and what to do if it gets worse.
- [Motorcycle air filter: when to clean or replace it](https://www.moto-log.app/blog/motorcycle-air-filter-when-to-clean-or-replace): A clogged air filter quietly costs you power and fuel. Here is how often to check your motorcycle's air filter, how to tell when it needs attention, and whether to clean or replace it.
- [Motorcycle warning lights explained: what each one means](https://www.moto-log.app/blog/motorcycle-warning-lights-explained): A light on the dash can mean anything from a reminder to a reason to stop right now. Here is what the common motorcycle warning lights mean and what to do about each one.
- [How to pack a motorcycle for a weekend trip](https://www.moto-log.app/blog/how-to-pack-a-motorcycle-for-a-weekend-trip): Packing a motorcycle is a balancing act, literally. Here is what to bring for a weekend away, how to carry it, and how to load the bike so it still handles well.
- [Motorcycle battery care: how to keep it charged and healthy](https://www.moto-log.app/blog/motorcycle-battery-care): A flat battery is one of the most common reasons a motorcycle will not start. Here is why bike batteries die, how to test yours, and how to make it last.
- [How to choose motorcycle gloves](https://www.moto-log.app/blog/how-to-choose-motorcycle-gloves): Your hands work the throttle, brakes and clutch, and they are usually the first thing to touch the ground in a fall. Here is how to pick gloves that protect them and still let you ride well.
- [Motorcycle tyre care: pressure, tread and age](https://www.moto-log.app/blog/motorcycle-tyre-care-pressure-tread-and-age): Two small contact patches are all that hold your motorcycle to the road. Here is how to check tyre pressure, tread and age, and when it is time for a new pair.
- [How to ride a motorcycle in the rain](https://www.moto-log.app/blog/how-to-ride-a-motorcycle-in-the-rain): Rain does not have to end a ride. Smooth inputs, the right lines and a bike in good shape make wet roads far less stressful. Here is how to ride them with confidence.
- [Motorcycle brakes: when to replace pads and fluid](https://www.moto-log.app/blog/motorcycle-brake-pads-and-fluid-when-to-replace): Brakes wear slowly, so the change is easy to miss until it matters. Here is how to check your pads and fluid, and how often to replace them.
- [How to get your motorcycle ready for a long trip](https://www.moto-log.app/blog/get-your-motorcycle-ready-for-a-long-trip): A long ride puts more miles on your bike in a few days than it might see in a month. Here is what to check before you leave, so the trip is about the road and not the hard shoulder.
- [The basic toolkit every rider should own](https://www.moto-log.app/blog/basic-motorcycle-toolkit-every-rider-should-own): You don't need a workshop to look after your bike. A small, well-chosen set of tools covers most of the jobs that keep it running well between services.
- [How to store your motorcycle for winter](https://www.moto-log.app/blog/how-to-store-your-motorcycle-for-winter): A few hours of preparation in autumn means a bike that starts first time in spring. Here is what to do before you park it up, and what to check when you bring it back.
- [How often should you change your motorcycle's oil?](https://www.moto-log.app/blog/how-often-change-motorcycle-oil): Oil is the cheapest insurance your engine has. Here is how to work out the right interval for your bike, and how to stop it slipping past.
- [Motorcycle chain maintenance: clean, lube and adjust](https://www.moto-log.app/blog/motorcycle-chain-maintenance): A neglected chain wears out sprockets, costs power and can fail at the worst time. A few minutes of regular care keeps it quiet and safe.
- [Why you should track your motorcycle's mileage](https://www.moto-log.app/blog/why-track-motorcycle-mileage): Your odometer is more useful than it looks. Logging it regularly makes servicing, budgeting and resale easier.
- [The 5-minute pre-ride check every rider should do](https://www.moto-log.app/blog/five-minute-pre-ride-check): A quick walk around the bike before you set off catches most problems while they are still small. Here is a simple routine you can repeat every time.
- [How to plan a motorcycle trip you will actually enjoy](https://www.moto-log.app/blog/how-to-plan-a-motorcycle-trip): A good ride starts before you leave the driveway. Plan the route, the stops and the bike, and the trip takes care of itself.
- [A simple motorcycle maintenance schedule](https://www.moto-log.app/blog/motorcycle-maintenance-schedule): Oil, chain, tyres, brake fluid and more: what to look at, how often, and how to keep it all straight without a notebook.
- [How a service history helps your motorcycle sell for more](https://www.moto-log.app/blog/service-history-motorcycle-resale-value): Buyers pay more for a bike they can trust. A clear record of services and mileage is one of the easiest ways to show that.
- [Buying a used motorcycle: the checklist to run before you pay](https://www.moto-log.app/blog/buying-a-used-motorcycle-checklist): A used bike is only a good deal if you know what you are buying. Here is what to ask, check and walk away from.
- [How to choose a motorcycle helmet that fits and lasts](https://www.moto-log.app/blog/how-to-choose-a-motorcycle-helmet): The best helmet is the one that fits your head and gets worn every ride. Here is how to pick one and know when to replace it.
- [Five riding skills to practise in an empty car park](https://www.moto-log.app/blog/five-riding-skills-to-practise-in-a-car-park): You do not need a track day to ride better. A quiet car park and an hour is enough to build skills that matter on the road.
- [Motorcycle service intervals: a plain-English cheat sheet](https://www.moto-log.app/blog/motorcycle-service-intervals-cheat-sheet): How often does a motorcycle really need servicing? Typical intervals for common jobs, and why your owner's manual always has the last word.
